'''Sakal''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Private/Legends|private]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] inside [[Olaris]].
